# Ralph loop

Study @fix_plan.md and the specs. Then, in this order:

1. Pick the most important unchecked item of fix_plan.md.
2. Implement it, and only it.
3. Run the tests. If they are red, go back to step 2 and fix them (up to 3 attempts).
4. Check the box in fix_plan.md and commit.

Stop when there are no unchecked items left in fix_plan.md, or after 20 iterations.
